title: Texture Hunt in the Park
description: Find a tree with peeling or rough bark, touch it, and photograph the texture up close. Take a moment to feel the difference between the rough bark and a smooth leaf nearby.
proofRubric: The photo must be a close-up showing the texture of tree bark.
safetyNotes: Watch your step around uneven ground and roots.
locationHint: Any nearby park or street with mature trees.
